key_evidence_spans: A 28-year-old G2P1 woman presented 31 days after an elective cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia with worsening headache and easy fatigability for 3 days
The headache was continuous, global, and had become severe over 24 hours, associated with nausea and malaise
Noncontrast CT of the head revealed a layered hypodense crescent-shaped extra-axial collection over the left frontoparietal convexity
with areas of linear and crescentic hyperdensity, measuring 15 mm in width with a 13-mm midline shift
all meningeal signs were negative, and motor function was intact
Laboratory studies showed a normal complete blood count, prothrombin time, partial prothrombin time, and international normalized ratio
